## B. Square to GoHighLevel

**In simple words:** keeps GoHighLevel up to date with the Square calendar.

- **When a booking changes** (Square tells us right away): adds **sq-booked**, **sq-cancelled**, **sq-late-cancel** or **sq-no-show**.
- **Every hour:** adds **sq-remind-48h**, **sq-remind-2h** or **sq-completed** at the right time.

It also fills in the appointment time, stylist and service on the contact. GoHighLevel workflows send the texts.
